controllerContract.arguments: { icon(name): SVG string, escape(value): HTML-safe string, toast(message): void, motionAllowed(): boolean }
controllerContract.returns: { element: HTMLElement, activate(): void, deactivate(): void, dispose(): void }
controllerContract.lifecycle: One cached controller per medium and demo role. Parent preserves its actual DOM across shell updates and navigation. activate refreshes measurements; deactivate pauses preview playback but does not discard drafts or cancel a local render; dispose cancels work, removes listeners, stops media tracks and revokes owned object URLs.
controllerContract.events: Own controls use data-image-action, data-video-action or data-audio-action. Do not use shared data-action, data-page, data-tool or demo-composer IDs for internal controls. Every input has a stable medium-prefixed ID. Mutate the retained workspace DOM, not the dashboard renderer.
controllerContract.data: State and at most six output records stay local to the controller. Do not claim production saves, prices for unsupported audio services, successful provider calls, or Library publication that does not occur.

studioPlan.chatHost: Stable same-origin iframe outside the replaced dashboard DOM. A preview-only Vite entry imports the unchanged ChatFullPage, original providers and CSS. Install a no-passthrough in-memory fetch adapter before mounting for /api/user, /api/c/am, /api/c/h, /api/c/h/:id, /api/c/s SSE and announcement. Deny network connections in the frame CSP; bridge known navigation and theme events to the parent.

voiceEndpoint.json: { text: trimmed string of 1–800 characters, voice: 'david'|'zira', rate: integer -2 through 2 }
voiceEndpoint.success: audio/wav generated in memory by installed offline Windows System.Speech voices; no file, database or cloud writes.
voiceEndpoint.errors: Non-2xx JSON { message }. Reject unknown voices, invalid input/content type and cross-origin requests. Bound execution time and terminate the owned speech process on cancellation.
voiceEndpoint.voiceTruth: Microsoft David Desktop and Microsoft Zira Desktop were confirmed installed. They are English local demonstration voices, not a production AI voice catalog.

localRendering.image: Canvas-based local graphic composition; prompt/preset, dimensions and variation selection affect the actual preview and downloadable PNG. Label it as local demo rendering, not generated provider imagery.
localRendering.video: Canvas captureStream plus supported WebM MediaRecorder. Record an actual short local storyboard clip with working playback, seek and download; no dummy still image posing as video.
localRendering.music: OfflineAudioContext synthesis with actual mood/tempo/duration controls, waveform analysis, playback and PCM WAV export. Label procedural local music as a demonstration, not an AI-provider result.
